text:
Leo (Partnerships): Quick thread for Azure Offer certification blockers we hit in validation: publisher id mismatch, missing privacy policy link, and telemetry disclosure for usage metering. Can owners chime in?
Priya (Marketplace): The portal returned error `OFFER_VALIDATION_102` — missing partner logo alt text and no Terms URL. Also Azure wants a machine-readable manifest (offer.json) with region matrix.
Marco (Legal): For telemetry: we need a short disclosure line explaining meter telemetry (no PII collected, aggregated token counts). I'll draft a paragraph but need product-confirmed list of telemetry keys.
Tess (Finance): Billing note: Azure supports both fixed monthly price and metered usage. If we choose metered, finance needs the metric id mapping so invoices map to our internal SKU codes. Send example usage line items.
Kofi (Cloud): Technical: our VM image declares a license type; BYOL needs `licenseUri` in the manifest. Also Azure will reject if `osType` tag is missing on the marketplace artifact. I can update the image pipeline.
Nikki (Security): Certification includes a basic security self-attestation. We must attach SOC2 snapshot or AICPA letter. Also check that the health endpoint does not leak metadata. I'll run a scan.
Priya (Marketplace): Action items from portal: 1) upload 1024x1024 logo + alt text, 2) add privacy and terms URLs, 3) attach compliance artifacts, 4) upload offer.json, 5) set planIDs and pricing JSON.
Leo (Partnerships): Timeline constraint: Azure validation could take up to 7 business days after full submission. If we want to sync with the PR announcement, we need to submit by next Tuesday.
Marco (Legal): Draft telemetry disclosure: "We collect aggregated usage metrics (requests, tokens, instance-hours) to bill and improve the service. No customer plain-text content is retained for analytics." Feedback?
Kofi (Cloud): LGTM. I'll provide a sample healthcheck and confirm the `osType`/`licenseUri` fields tomorrow.
Tess (Finance): Please put pricing JSON like `{"planId":"business","meterId":"token_count","unit":"1k_tokens","priceCents":500}` into the shared spreadsheet so finance can map it to invoices.
Priya (Marketplace): Note: Private Azure Marketplace requires a different offer visibility setting and an alternate legal attestation. If customer wants private listing, we'll need an extra step.
Leo (Partnerships): Good catch. For initial launch let's do public listing; we can follow with private offers for named customers.
marketplace-bot: Offer submission draft saved (draftId: dft-98321). Next validation run scheduled in 1 hour.
Marco (Legal): I'll upload the EULA + SOC2 redactions to the drive and tag in this thread when ready.
Nikki (Security): I'll run the vulnerability scan against the test image and post findings. If anything >HIGH, we block submission.
Priya (Marketplace): Small nit: Azure requires screenshot sizes 1200x675 for the banner. I updated the marketing assets doc.
Leo (Partnerships): Owners recap: Priya = portal + submission, Kofi = image/manifest, Marco = legal artifacts + telemetry text, Tess = billing mapping, Nikki = sec attestation. OK to close once draft passes Azure validation.
Kofi (Cloud): Confirmed. I'll push updated image and offer.json by EOD and post AMI/VM IDs.
Tess (Finance): I'll prepare the invoice mapping template and share a sheet.
Priya (Marketplace): Running validation now; will post the validation log here in ~1h.
marketplace-bot: Validation complete. Warnings: MKT-ALT-TEXT-MISSING; Errors: NONE.
Leo (Partnerships): Nice. Reconvene Friday AM if any outstanding issues. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
